scope: Current pinned Flutter 3.47.2/Dart 3.13.2 graph; official publisher changelogs reviewed

decisions.decision: Update to 1.0.9 patch; keep major 2 separate
decisions.reason: 1.0.9 removes an empty Dart file and requires Flutter3.35/Dart3.9, satisfied by this project. Major2 changes imports to cupertino_ui and minimum Flutter3.44/Dart3.12; no current icon defect requires that migration.

Major11 removes legacy crypto/backends and namespace options; migration of installed sessions must be verified from actual previously distributed app versions. Existing session store fixes have no new storage requirement. Update needs separate old-version upgrade/device test.

Major18 migrates to material_ui/cupertino_ui and raises SDK minimum; reviewed18.1.1 includes shell/observer fixes. Current static route topology has focused regressions; no confirmed audit finding requires new router API. Schedule module migration separately rather than mixing with lifecycle recovery fixes.

Major9 minimumAGP8.12.1 exceeds pinned8.11.1; major10 also changes transitive/native graph. Current metadata behavior is tested. Native toolchain upgrade and plugin upgrade need one coordinated reviewed change.

Major13 moves plugin compileSDK37;13.0.2 changes Android permanent-denial guidance. Application camera uses current supported permission flow; upgrade requiresSDK37/native acceptance before inclusion.

nativeToolchain.decision: Keep release/toolchain.json pins for this candidate
nativeToolchain.reason: AGP/Kotlin future Flutter support warnings are recorded; current pinned SDK builds must be rechecked. Upgrade only as coordinated graph/platform change, not to silence a future support warning.

notAClaim: New major versions alone are not security vulnerabilities. Dependency decisions do not close physical camera, upgrade or signing acceptance.
verification: flutter pub get changed exactly one dependency; final test and native build evidence recorded by coordinator
